title: 第3章 因祸得福修出后天之体第4章 奇思妙想
content_zh:
;;
“痴儿，张嘴，速速吞了这麒麟胆！”
听着脑海中的大喝，处在生死弥留之际的李向东用尽全身仅剩的力气。
嘴巴像濒临死亡的金鱼张开一丝缝隙。
咻！
那悬在眼前的金色光芒见缝插针飞速挤进来，沿着咽喉一路滚落腹中。
猛地爆发一股浓厚的生命精气，以腹部为中心，向着四肢百骸迅速蔓延。
李向东浑身四处摔断的骨头和内脏受损部位被这股生命精气一冲。
立即好似被舒服的温泉包裹，全部的痛楚消失。
随后咯织咯织的声音传出，大量断裂的骨头飞速生长出骨芽。
内脏也重新长出新肉。
仅仅一刻钟的时间，就完全复原，体格比起之间还要健壮许多。
“咦，不痛了，突然一点都不痛了！”
李向东飞快爬起来，正一脸憨傻着打量手脚，麒麟胆中最后的生命精气一分为二。
一道笔直向下，极速冲入下体关键部位，修复受损的肌肉组织。
一道笔直上升，猛地冲上头顶仙台，如秋风扫落叶一般修补受损的神经元。
没过多久。
麒麟胆中全部的生命精气耗尽，男儿本色不但恢复，还粗长了三分！
脑海中或失去或尘封的记忆，也如潮水一般涌进脑海回归。
看着一帧接一帧的惨痛经历迅速浮现在眼前，李向东身上的痴傻劲一扫而空。

全然明白这些日子所经历的前因后果！
想当年意气风发考上北青大学，人穷志不穷，大四没毕业就荣获得国家实验室资助的课题。
一时风头无俩！
正当他用这个课题做敲门砖，进到一家世界五百强的公司实习。
三年转正后年薪可达百万的时候。
在业内颇有声望的导师却污蔑他偷窃实验报告。
耍阴谋诡计把实验成果从他手里抢走，反过头还重重踩上一脚。
四处宣扬他品德欠佳。
硬生生把他从天之骄子的位置拉到人人唾弃的学术小偷泥潭。
万劫不复。
而那导师却凭借这份抢来的课题顺利加官进爵，事业名声双丰收！
日子过的有滋有味！
李向东当时为了这件事情曾四处伸冤，可惜身边没一个人帮忙。
反而都把他当过街老鼠，人人喊打。
导致他精神受到巨大打击好长一段时间都没缓过神。
content_en:
;;
"Idiot, open your mouth and swallow this unicorn guts quickly!"
Listening to the shouting in his mind, Li Xiangdong, who was on the verge of life and death, used up all the remaining strength in his body.
The mouth is open like a dying goldfish.
call out!
The golden light hanging in front of my eyes quickly squeezed in through every opportunity, and rolled down my throat and into my belly.
A thick life essence suddenly erupted, centered on the abdomen, and quickly spread to the limbs and bones.
Li Xiangdong's broken bones and damaged internal organs were washed away by this life energy.
Immediately it felt like being wrapped in a comfortable hot spring, and all the pain disappeared.
Then the sound of rattling was heard, and a large number of broken bones rapidly grew bone buds.
The internal organs also grow new flesh.
In just a quarter of an hour, he completely recovered, and his body was much stronger than before.
"Hey, it doesn't hurt anymore. Suddenly it doesn't hurt at all!"
Li Xiangdong quickly got up and was looking at his hands and feet with an innocent look on his face. The last life essence in Qilin's guts was split into two.
A straight line downwards, rushing into the key parts of the lower body at extremely high speed, repairing the damaged muscle tissue.
A straight line rises, rushing to the celestial platform above the head, repairing damaged neurons like the autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves.
It didn't take long.
All the life essence in Qilin Gu was exhausted, and the man's true colors were not only restored, but he also grew three points thicker!
Memories that have been lost or dusted in my mind also flood back into my mind like a tide.
Seeing the painful experience frame by frame quickly emerge in front of his eyes, Li Xiangdong's stupidity was wiped away.
I fully understand the causes and consequences of what I have experienced these days!
I remember that when I was admitted to Beiqing University with high spirits, I was poor and ambitious, and even before I graduated from my senior year, I was awarded a project funded by the national laboratory.
It’s all in the limelight for a moment!
Just as he was using this subject as a stepping stone, he entered an internship in a Fortune 500 company.
After becoming a regular employee in three years, the annual salary can reach one million.
A well-respected tutor in the industry accused him of stealing experimental reports.
She used intrigues to snatch the experimental results away from him, and then stepped on him hard.
His bad moral character is widely publicized.
He was abruptly dragged from the position of being the favored son of heaven to the quagmire of an academic thief despised by everyone.
There is no recovery.
However, the tutor successfully gained promotion to a noble position by virtue of this stolen project, and his career and reputation were both fruitful!
The life was enjoyable!
Li Xiangdong went around to seek justice for this matter, but unfortunately no one around him helped.
Instead, everyone treated him like a street rat, and everyone shouted to beat him.
As a result, he suffered a huge mental blow and could not recover for a long time.
